scope_note: Two-pass project-scoped audit of Apple Maiden under worker-research-contract 2.0.0. project_updates.title: Investment audit - actuals and commitments separated
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Apple newsroom/environmental archives, 2009 County/Town agreement minutes, Catawba FY2010-FY2026 budgets and ACFRs, NC Commerce/General Assembly grant reports, permits, assessor/tax pages, SEC/company filings and local reporting. Searches combined Apple, Project Dolphin, Maiden, Catawba, 5977/6028/6029 Startown, parcel 362711760090, the IM3 IDs, investment, capex, acquisition, equipment, expansion and financing across 2008-2026. Retained are the original $1 billion commitment, a county-reported FY2016/17 $432 million investment, the April 2022 $448 million expansion commitment and Apple's 2025 greater-than-$5-billion company/county cumulative lower bound. Their periods and scopes overlap, so they are never summed; no selected-building acquisition price, equipment ledger, annual capex series, debt, lease or verified $448 million realization was found.

project_updates.title: Construction audit - original and later phases bounded
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Catawba Building Services parcel/project/permit reports, MDN.06 index, Town/County minutes and planning documents, OSHA establishment searches, Apple announcements and contractor/architect searches. Exact identifiers and aliases covered 5977/6028/6029 Startown, 2201 Elbow, parcel 362711760090, BLDC-05-2022-171970, MDN.06, Maiden Tactical, Project Dolphin, Apple, Holder and Turner from 2008-2026. County FY2012 reporting supports more than 750 original construction jobs without hours or residence; the 2022 finaled MDN.06 report supports a separate 237,600-square-foot building and $25,176,096 administrative permit value. Three later MDN.06 building permits and the 2012 tactical/fuel-cell facility remain distinct; no complete permit valuation, contractor-payment, payroll, job-year, local-labor or selected-building cost ledger was found.

project_updates.title: Supplier audit - named firms without spend retained as context
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: permit contractor/contact fields, Apple supplier and newsroom materials, county procurement/vendor and check-search terms, contractor case studies, OSHA, local business reporting and SEC filings. Queries combined Apple Maiden and exact addresses/parcel with Holder Construction, Turner Construction, Skidmore Builders, architects, fuel cells, solar, fiber, vendor, subcontractor, invoice, contract, procurement, local spend and Catawba supplier from 2008-2026. Holder is named in contemporary construction reporting, Turner in the 2022 occupancy report and Skidmore on a 2020 patio permit, but none discloses payment, worker residence or a bounded local share. No complete vendor roster, supplier geography, purchase amount, operating procurement, local-retention rate or non-overlap ledger was found.

project_updates.title: Operations audit - campus snapshots without payroll
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Catawba ACFR/budget histories, Apple jobs/current campus pages, environmental reports, AWS certification, LinkedIn/job-board searches, NC Commerce/workforce sources, BLS/QCEW and local reporting. Searches used Apple Maiden, iCloud, Project Dolphin, the exact addresses/parcel and IM3 IDs with employee, FTE, contractor, technician, payroll, wage, benefits, occupation, shift, residence, turnover, revenue and operating expense across 2009-2026. Retained separately are the county's 2012 greater-than-100 Apple-badged and 150 contractor snapshots and its current-overview 150 new-job and 250 contractor figures; wording and dates do not permit a time-series reconciliation. Current vacancies are not headcount. No annual FTE, payroll, wages, benefits, worker residence, turnover, operating expense, revenue or building-level staffing was found.

project_updates.title: Fiscal audit - existing valuation series remains controlling
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Catawba Tax Department/ITSPublicCT, parcel 362711760090, County FY2009-FY2025 ACFRs, adopted budgets, top-taxpayer tables, collection reports, Town of Maiden budgets and minutes, and state tax/statutory materials. Queries used Apple Inc., Project Dolphin, the three Startown addresses, parcel and IM3 IDs with bill, account, assessed/appraised/taxable value, levy, paid, receipt, delinquent, refund, distribution, sales/use tax and PILOT across 2009-2026. The eight existing FY2013-FY2016 and FY2022-FY2025 company/county assessed-value actuals remain controlling and the current tax page corroborates FY2025 $1,476,648,949. The portal did not yield an auditable account bill/payment export; no parcel-specific tax, Town receipt, jurisdictional distribution, sales tax, refund or net fiscal ledger was found.

project_updates.title: Public-cost audit - realized county series replaces percentage inference
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: the 2009 County/Town incentive resolutions and agreement terms, Catawba budget organization 420050 tables, ACFR notes, check-register/payment searches, Town budgets, NC One Fund/IDF reports, state incentives/statutes, infrastructure and public-safety records. Queries combined Apple, Dolphin, Maiden, Catawba, exact addresses/parcel with incentive, EDC Apple, grant, abatement, refund, appropriation, reimbursement, clawback, fire station, water loop, sewer and road from 2009-2026. Six actual county EDC Apple expense observations are retained for FY2015 and FY2019-FY2023, separately from the $344,947 approved state grant and the conditional 50/85-percent local formulas. No Town payment series, grant disbursement date, tax-expenditure counterfactual, infrastructure cost allocation, marginal service cost or complete public-cost ledger was found; missing years are not interpolated.

project_updates.title: Resource audit - long electricity series, no public water volumes
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Apple environmental reports for 2012-2026, the AWS audit/certified-site register, City of Hickory water and Town of Maiden wastewater pages/reports, Duke Energy/NCUC tariff and docket searches, NCDEQ air/waste/stormwater records, EIA and renewable-project inventories. Exact entity/address/parcel queries included electricity, kWh, demand, bill, meter, rate, interconnection, PUE, WUE, water, gallons, withdrawal, wastewater, blowdown, generator, fuel, gas and emissions. Apple directly reports a FY2016-FY2025 campus electricity series rising from 244 to 470 million kWh; it is retained unallocated. AWS confirms Hickory/Lake Hickory supply and Maiden wastewater service but publishes no site bill or volume. Cooling-control savings are forecasts, zero gas is not zero backup fuel, and no water use, discharge, utility price, peak demand, PUE, generator count/runtime or selected-building resource record was found.

project_updates.title: Community audit - statewide commitments not assigned to Maiden
project_updates.notes: Source families checked: Apple newsroom/environment/community archives, Catawba and Maiden agendas/budgets, school/community-college and nonprofit recipient sites, foundation/IRS searches, local media and workforce-training records. Searches combined Apple Maiden/Catawba/Startown with donation, grant, sponsorship, scholarship, school, CVCC, training, apprenticeship, nonprofit, fire, broadband, road, community and recipient names across 2009-2026. Apple's 2021 $100 million North Carolina schools/community fund and greater-than-$110-million statewide infrastructure commitment are broader state programs with no public Maiden allocation, and supplier-impact programs are company-wide. No recipient-confirmed project cash/in-kind amount, apprenticeship payment, workforce grant or campus community ledger was found.

project_updates.title: Boundary and chronology gap closure
project_updates.project_description: Apple Maiden is the operating data-center campus at 5977 Startown Road in Catawba County, North Carolina, opened in June 2010 and now comprising three primary data-center buildings plus service structures. This account follows the IM3-selected 564,402-square-foot main building footprint while keeping campuswide electricity, employment, investment, tax, incentive, utility and permit evidence explicitly unallocated. It distinguishes the original facility from 2012 tactical/fuel-cell work, the 2022 MDN.06 237,600-square-foot building and the expansion under construction in 2025.
project_updates.notes: Gap closure cross-checked the IM3 building polygon/coordinates and campus relationship against AWS coordinates 35.588 N, 81.263 W, the exact 5977 Startown address, parcel 362711760090, county permit chronology, Apple operation-since/opening language, environmental reports and later-expansion announcements. AWS's water-certification scope is the land west of Startown Road and lists three primary data-center buildings, preventing a campus-equals-building assumption. Parcel, permit, campus and company/county facts remain unallocated unless a source explicitly identifies the selected unit; address variants 5977, 6028, 6029 Startown and 2201 Elbow denote related but not interchangeable property/facility records.

project_updates.title: Government, legal, archive and financing gap closure
project_updates.notes: Gap closure returned to Catawba County and Town of Maiden minutes/agendas/ACFRs/budgets, tax and permit portals, NCDEQ Laserfiche/air lists, NC Commerce and General Assembly reports, NCUC/Duke materials, SEC EDGAR and web archives using Apple Inc., Project Dolphin, RCRA NCR000149526, air facility 1800557/permit 10040R07, exact addresses, parcel, IM3 IDs, deed, lien, UCC, bond, financing, litigation, penalty, settlement and compliance. The 2017 RCRA order establishes regulated operations and assessed penalty/costs but not payment and has no compatible penalty metric. No facility financing, deed consideration, bond, lease economics, tax litigation outcome, paid penalty ledger, public loan or selected-building asset ledger surfaced.

project_updates.title: Candidate-by-candidate modeling and county-outcome decision
project_updates.notes: Metric-specific eligibility review after both direct-evidence passes. Investment: rejected - cumulative, annual-highlight, commitment and permit amounts overlap and lack a selected-building allocation. Construction: rejected - worker residence, hours, payroll, local coefficients and a complete non-overlap permit/spend ledger are absent. Suppliers: rejected - contractor identities without payments, geography or local shares cannot support output. Operations: rejected - inconsistent dated headcount/contractor snapshots cannot generate annual FTE, payroll, wages, revenue or expense. Fiscal: rejected - assessed-value stocks and published rates cannot substitute for account bills, recipient receipts, refunds or incidence. Public costs: rejected - actual county payments have gaps, Town payments and same-scope service/infrastructure costs are missing, and applying the 50/85-percent formulas would create a counterfactual rather than an observation. Resources: rejected - campus kWh cannot be allocated to one building, and no meter, peak, PUE/WUE, water, fuel or cost inputs exist. Community: rejected - no project-attributable recipient amount exists. County employment: rejected - CBP/QCEW aggregates cannot isolate Apple, contractors or concurrent data-center activity and no defensible comparison design exists. County wages: rejected - composition change is not project payroll and has the same identification failure. County GDP: rejected - BEA county output has no validated treatment share, comparator or attribution design. Modeled additions: zero; forecasts added: four. Remaining gaps stay explicit rather than using arbitrary building shares, tax-rate multiplication, capacity conversion, transferred multipliers or unsupported causal effects.
